description: 3D buildings 2020 (LOD2 model with textures) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Digital model of 3D LOD2 buildings with textures in CityGML, 3DM and GDB format and in DWG format without textures of some Montreal boroughs.This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
